Package edu.secourse.patientportal.response

Class MLogixApiResponse<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.response.MLogixApiResponse<T>
Type Parameters:
T - Generic type for response data
public class MLogixApiResponse<T> extends Object
Generic API Response Wrapper for MacLogix REST API This class wraps all API responses to provide consistent response format across all endpoints. Response Structure: { "success": true/false, "message": "Human readable message", "timestamp": "2026-01-18T10:30:00", "statusCode": 200, "data": { ... } } Benefits: - Consistent response format across all endpoints - Easy for client applications to parse - Includes timestamp for audit/debugging - Supports both single object and paginated data Usage Examples: - Success: ApiResponse.success("Login successful", loginData, 200) - Error: ApiResponse.error("Invalid credentials", 401) - Paginated: ApiResponse.success("Patients retrieved", pageData, 200)
